title.en: Keep up with a fast voice chat
title.es: Seguir una charla rápida entre amigos

es: Seguir un chat de voz grupal a ritmo natural y responder con datos exactos, una razón y una contrapropuesta en registro informal, apoyándote en formas reducidas, enlaces y transcripción.

teaching.en: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight, so count me in if you're up for it.
teaching.es: Voy a reservar las entradas esta noche, así que cuenta conmigo si tú también tienes ganas.
teaching.explanationEs: Count me in significa que aceptas el plan; up for it indica que te apetece hacerlo.
segments: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight, so count
me in if you're up for it.
teaching.audioText: I'm gonna book the tickets tonight, so count me in if you're up for it.

teaching.en: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal, as long as everyone can chip in for the food.
teaching.es: El domingo a mediodía me viene bien, así que hecho, siempre que todos puedan aportar algo para la comida.
teaching.explanationEs: Works for me acepta una propuesta; deal cierra el acuerdo; chip in reparte el gasto.
segments: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal,
as long as everyone can chip in for the food.
teaching.audioText: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal, as long as everyone can chip in for the food.

teaching.en: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday? I gotta work until six, but I'd hate to cancel, so let's meet halfway.
teaching.es: ¿Podemos cambiar el sábado por el domingo? Tengo que trabajar hasta las seis, pero no quiero cancelar, así que busquemos un punto medio.
teaching.explanationEs: Swap A for B: cambiar una cosa por otra, con la razón detrás; meet halfway propone un término medio.
segments: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday? I gotta work until
six, but I'd hate to cancel, so let's meet halfway.
teaching.audioText: Can we swap Saturday for Sunday? I gotta work until six, but I'd hate to cancel, so let's meet halfway.

teaching.en: No worries, we can go on Sunday instead, and Leo can tag along if he finishes early.
teaching.es: No pasa nada, podemos ir el domingo en su lugar, y Leo puede unirse si termina pronto.
teaching.explanationEs: No worries quita tensión y acepta el cambio; tag along es sumarse a un plan ya hecho.
segments: No worries, we can go on Sunday instead, and
Leo can tag along if he finishes early.

teaching.en: I can't make it on Saturday, so let's swap days, or I can take a rain check and join the next one.
teaching.es: No puedo ir el sábado, así que cambiemos de día, o lo dejo para otra ocasión y me uno a la próxima.
teaching.explanationEs: Take a rain check: rechazar ahora dejando la puerta abierta para otro día.
segments: I can't make it on Saturday, so let's swap days, or
I can take a rain check and join the next one.

teaching.en: Whaddya say we book a table for six, and everyone chips in twenty pounds?
teaching.es: ¿Qué tal si reservamos una mesa para seis y cada uno pone veinte libras?
teaching.explanationEs: Whaddya say + we + verbo lanza una propuesta informal al grupo.
segments: Whaddya say we book a table for

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Mia y elige cuál es la postura de Leo ante el plan.

choices.text: He accepts, but only if the price goes down.
He refuses politely and asks for another day.
He accepts the plan without any conditions.

feedback.es: Leo responde «count me in» de inmediato y sin condiciones: acepta el plan tal como está.

hint.es: Fíjate en cómo responde Leo y si añade alguna condición.

origin.audio: In the voice chat, Mia says she's gonna book the tickets tonight for Saturday's concert at seven thirty, and she asks who is in. Leo answers immediately: count me in, I'm really up for it.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje de Tom. ¿Qué hace exactamente?

choices.text: He declines the day, gives a reason and suggests another time.
He turns the plan down and offers no alternative.
He accepts the plan but asks for more details.

feedback.es: Tom rechaza el sábado, da una razón breve y propone el domingo a mediodía: reacción, razón y contrapropuesta.

hint.es: Busca las tres partes del patrón: reacción, razón y contrapropuesta.

origin.text: Tom's message: 'Saturday doesn't work for me; I gotta work until six. What about Sunday at noon instead?'

prompt.es: Ordena: «El domingo a mediodía me viene bien, así que hecho.»

answer.text: Sunday at noon works for me, so it's a deal

feedback.es: Works for me acepta la propuesta y so it's a deal cierra el acuerdo.

hint.es: Empieza por el día y la hora.

prompt.es: Escucha la charla y elige cuánto pagará cada uno al final.

choices.text: Thirty pounds for each ticket.
Thirty-five pounds each.
Fifty pounds for each ticket.

feedback.es: Mia propone un compromiso de treinta y cinco libras por persona y todos lo aceptan; treinta y cincuenta eran las ofertas de partida.

origin.audio: The four friends are still arguing about the concert. Sara says the tickets are fifty pounds each and the show starts at seven thirty. Tom replies that fifty is a lot for him and asks whether they could swap to the cheaper seats at thirty pounds. Leo is up for it, but Mia would rather keep the good seats, so she suggests a compromise: thirty-five pounds each, in the middle block. In the end everyone agrees, and they arrange to meet at the station at six forty-five.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige a qué hora quedan en la estación.

choices.text: At six fifteen, before the doors open.
At seven thirty, when the concert begins.
At six forty-five, at the station.

feedback.es: La cita en la estación es a las seis cuarenta y cinco; las siete y media es la hora del concierto.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión del chat con su función.

pairs: I'd rather take a rain check

feedback.es: Cada expresión cumple una función distinta en un chat: aceptar, negociar, repartir el gasto y aplazar con cortesía.

pairs: I'd rather take a rain check

prompt.es: Escucha la charla y elige cómo reacciona Tom ante la oferta de Sara.

choices.text: He prefers not to accept help and will join them later.
He wants a more expensive restaurant for the birthday.
He forgot that the dinner was on Friday evening.

feedback.es: Tom rechaza la ayuda con «no worries», aplaza la cena con un rain check y se une después para el café.

origin.audio: Carlos's birthday is on Friday, and the group is deciding where to go. Ana suggests the Italian place by the river, but Tom points out that it's kinda expensive, and he's gonna be short of money until Monday. Sara offers to cover his share, yet Tom says no worries, he would rather take a rain check and join them for coffee afterwards. Mia then proposes a cheaper pizza place, booked for eight, where everyone splits the bill.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez y elige qué sugiere la propuesta final de Mia.

choices.text: That the birthday should be moved to Monday.
That she wants a plan everybody can afford.
That Ana's idea was the best one for everybody.

feedback.es: Un restaurante más barato donde todos dividen la cuenta sugiere que Mia busca un plan que todos puedan pagar.

prompt.es: Completa: Leo salió pronto del trabajo y decidió «sumarse» al plan.

feedback.es: Tag along es el verbo frasal para sumarse a un plan ya organizado por otros.

origin.text: Leo finished work early, so he decided to ___ along with the others and see the concert after all.

prompt.es: Responde al chat: acepta, da datos exactos y contrapropón una hora con una razón.

answer.text: Hey everyone! Count me in for Saturday, it sounds great. The concert starts at seven thirty, so we can't be late, and fifty pounds each is kinda expensive, but I'm up for it. Lemme ask something: can we meet at the station at half past six instead of six? I gotta finish work at six, and the station is ten minutes away from the office. Also, what about buying the cheaper seats? They're thirty pounds, so we'd save twenty each. If it rains, we can take the bus instead of walking. Sara, could you book the tickets tonight? Let me know, thanks! I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. See you all on Saturday!
accepted: Hey everyone! Count me in for Saturday, it sounds great. The concert starts at seven thirty, so we can't be late, and fifty pounds each is kinda expensive, but I'm up for it. Lemme ask something: can we meet at the station at half past six instead of six? I gotta finish work at six, and the station is ten minutes away from the office. Also, what about buying the cheaper seats? They're thirty pounds, so we'd save twenty each. If it rains, we can take the bus instead of walking. Sara, could you book the tickets tonight? Let me know, thanks! I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. See you all on Saturday!

Hi all! I'm in for Saturday. The concert starts at seven thirty, so we gotta be on time. Fifty pounds each is a lot, but it's a deal, I'll come. Can we meet at the station at six thirty instead of six? I gotta work until six, and I need time to get there. What about taking the bus instead of a taxi? It's cheaper. Mia, are you gonna book the tickets tonight? Let me know! I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. If it rains, we can take an umbrella and go anyway. See you all on Saturday!

Hello everyone! Count me in. The concert is at half past seven and the tickets are 50 pounds each, so let's be careful with money. I dunno if six works for me, because I gotta finish work first. Can we meet at 6.30 instead? I'll take the bus and arrive on time. No worries if that is a problem, just tell me. Who's gonna book the tickets? I can do it tonight if you want. I'm really looking forward to it, and I think it's gonna be a great night. If it rains, we can take an umbrella and go anyway. See you all on Saturday!

feedback.es: La respuesta acepta el plan, repite hora y precio, contrapropone con razón y usa alguna forma reducida en registro informal.

origin.text: Mensajes del chat — Mia: «The concert is on Saturday at seven thirty. Who's in?» Leo: «The tickets are fifty pounds each.» Tom: «Let's meet at the station at six.» Responde en registro informal: acepta el plan, repite la hora del concierto y el precio, y contrapropón otra hora de encuentro con tu razón. Usa al menos una forma reducida.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de Sara y elige qué deja entrever sobre los cambios anteriores.

choices.text: That she is happy to change everything again.
That she does not care which day they finally choose.
That she is a little impatient with the earlier changes.

feedback.es: «Please don't change your minds again» revela cierta impaciencia por los cambios anteriores.

origin.audio: Hi all, it's Sara. I'm gonna book the tickets now, so please don't change your minds again. Sunday is fine by me, but I can't meet at noon; I'd rather make it one o'clock, because my shift finishes at half past twelve. Meet me at the gate, not at the station.

prompt.es: Completa: el domingo «me viene bien», pero prefiero una hora más tarde.

feedback.es: Works for me es la fórmula informal para aceptar una propuesta, aunque luego se pida un ajuste.

origin.text: Honestly, Sunday ___ for me, but could we make it one o'clock? I finish work at half past twelve.

prompt.es: Elige la respuesta que rechaza la hora con naturalidad y propone otra.

choices.text: Nine's a bit late for me, honestly; could we make it half past seven?
Nine is impossible for me; I cannot accept any dinner that late.
Nine's perfect, count me in, but I'd rather skip dinner and have coffee.

feedback.es: Tom explica con suavidad por qué no le viene bien y propone otra hora; las demás opciones son tajantes o se contradicen.

origin.text: Mia asks: 'Dinner at nine on Friday?' Tom cannot stay out that late, but he wants to go.
